name: Vnc → Send Pointer
description: Sends a mouse event at a position on the server's screen.

config_entries.label: Buttons
config_entries.description: The buttons held down, as a list of names (`left`, `middle`, `right`, `wheel_up`, `wheel_down`) or a number. A lambda returns the number: the sum of `1` left, `2` middle, `4` right, `8` wheel up and `16` wheel down. Defaults to none, which releases all buttons. A click is one event with the button and one without it. A scroll step is one event with `wheel_up` or `wheel_down` and one without.
